name: Codex 折叠渲染
description: 按 phase 归组渲染模型回答：中间旁白、思考与工具调用收进一个可展开分组，生成时显示工作中，完成后显示用时并自动折叠，只留最终答案平铺。
descriptionEn: Groups reasoning, commentary and tool calls into one collapsible block per turn. Shows a working indicator while running and the elapsed time when done, leaving only the final answer flat.

name: 额度与成本
description: 会话级多模型账本：按 API 提供商和模型连续累计成本、显示 token 与有效单价；订阅明确不计费。
descriptionEn: Conversation-level multi-model ledger: continuous cost totals by API provider and model, token and effective-rate details, with subscription calls explicitly excluded.

name: 聊天归档
description: 本地持久聊天归档：保留压缩前原文、按分支浏览历史、问题跳转与 Markdown 文件查看；不调用模型，不修改原会话。
descriptionEn: Persistent local chat archive preserving pre-compaction originals, with branch history, question navigation and a Markdown file viewer. No model calls or native-session edits.

name: 模型调度
description: 按时段配置主 bot 与子 bot 的模型/思考档位：可视化编辑时间窗（时区可搜索选择 + 本地时间预览）、可折叠窗口卡、当前生效窗口高亮、永不生效窗口告警与未保存修改保护，写入 ~/.pi/agent/model-schedule.jsonc，保存即生效。
descriptionEn: Time-of-day model routing for main/sub bots: searchable timezone picker with live local time, collapsible window cards, current-window highlight, never-matching window warnings and unsaved-change protection, written to ~/.pi/agent/model-schedule.jsonc.

name: Photon iMessage
description: Photon iMessage 通道：经本机 Photon sidecar（spectrum-ts gRPC 桥）在 Linux/macOS 上收发 iMessage，零公网 IP。机器人循环、输入动效、用户白名单、多轮会话隔离、/sessions 投票气泡切会话、斜杠命令与 AI photon 工具一应俱全。
descriptionEn: Photon iMessage channel for pi-web-ui: send & receive iMessages on Linux/macOS via a local Photon sidecar (spectrum-ts gRPC bridge) with zero public IP. Bot loop, typing indicator, allowlist, per-sender session isolation, a native-poll session picker, slash commands and the AI photon tool included.
iconSvg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M21 15a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H7l-4 4V5a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h14a2 2 0 0 1 2 2z"/></svg>

name: multi-git
description: 多仓库 Git 总览：工作区内每个仓库的变更、差异、历史、分支、贮藏、跨仓搜索与时间线，另有工作区分支聚合、Fetch/Pull 与内置终端（其余只读）。
descriptionEn: Multi-repo Git overview: changes, diffs, history, branches, stashes, cross-repo search and a timeline for every repository in the workspace, plus a workspace-wide branch view, Fetch/Pull and an optional terminal.
iconSvg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><circle cx="12" cy="18" r="3"/><circle cx="6" cy="6" r="3"/><circle cx="18" cy="6" r="3"/><path d="M18 9v2c0 .6-.4 1-1 1H7c-.6 0-1-.4-1-1V9"/><path d="M12 12v3"/></svg>

name: 代理健康
description: 探测可配置的 HTTPS 目标及代理链路；无代理时检测直连，失败时对比第二目标，谨慎提示网络问题。
descriptionEn: Probe a configurable HTTPS target via an HTTP(S) proxy or directly; compare a second site on failure without assuming the root cause.

name: 重连
description: 断连恢复：查看网页服务与重启守护状态，一键重新连接或重启网页服务（支持单服务/全服务重启，配套可选独立守护进程）。
descriptionEn: Reconnection & service recovery: inspect web service and companion watchdog health, reconnect or restart services in one click (supports multi-service restarts with companion watchdog).
iconSvg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M3 12a9 9 0 0 1 9-9 9.75 9.75 0 0 1 6.74 2.74L21 8"/><path d="M21 3v5h-5"/><path d="M21 12a9 9 0 0 1-9 9 9.75 9.75 0 0 1-6.74-2.74L3 16"/><path d="M3 21v-5h5"/></svg>

name: 会话归档
description: 左栏会话行内的「收起」按钮：把对话从侧边栏收起来，不删文件、不申请目录授权，也不保存副本（要看历史全文请配 md-chat 之类阅读器）。可设 1/7/30 天或永不到期；到期默认只提醒，手动确认才删文件。附管理面板：恢复（自动展开所在项目、滚动并闪烁定位）与最近删除记录。
descriptionEn: A tuck-away button in each sidebar row: hides a chat without deleting files, without directory access and without keeping a copy (use md-chat for history). 1/7/30-day or never expiry; expiry only reminds and deletion needs confirmation. Restores with auto-expand, scroll and flash.

name: 用量账本
description: 记录 pi-web-ui 自己的每一次模型调用：按模型统计调用数、TTFT、延迟、吞吐、缓存命中率、token 与成本，可查看逐条记录、按模型筛选并导出 CSV。成本优先用 SDK 记录，网关不回填时按公开价格表估算并分开展示；数据只来自本机会话与运行事件，不上传任何内容。
descriptionEn: Records every model call inside pi-web-ui: per-model counts, TTFT, latency, throughput, cache hit rate, tokens and cost. Cost prefers the SDK value and falls back to public price tables when the gateway reports zero, shown separately; data comes only from local sessions and run events.
